deferred.title: facts / F4 (conditional fact extraction)
deferred.protocol: Task 5 diagnostic leg under C-1, pre-registered in Task 4: per suite x model (beam-100k/dev, locomo/dev, longmemeval-m/dev), run the best read-time arm (gather + expansion + card excerpt + grouping) and the oracle arm on the same questions with validated ingestion. A failure counts toward extraction only if the oracle answers it, the read-time arm does not, the report's evidenceCounts show the gold evidence was delivered or was a candidate, the ability is state or aggregation, and the failure id is unique (repeats collapsed). Source and protocol hashes are pinned.
deferred.rule: complete attribution and < 5% -> not-needed (F4's remedy closed; the existing extractor is not thereby declared reliable); >= 5% irrecoverable in any suite x model -> fix-and-measure, the original scoped Task 17 remedy (opt-in `conversational-facts`); incomplete attribution -> stays unmeasured and no preset is built. Task 13's >= 5% shared-entity/not-in-query condition is kept separately; no graph store.

deferred.title: typed-link association
deferred.protocol: Recorded from the same diagnostic leg: failures where the gold evidence shares an entity with a hit but no query term (counted from evidenceCounts and the term sets, no text).
deferred.rule: >= 5% of a suite x model's failures -> reconsider typed links (owner gate); otherwise stays closed. No graph store is authorized.
